items.title: Billions on paper: How much of Luzon Corridor’s $20-B pipeline will become real?
items.description: Rappler worked with an independent research analyst to see how much of the Luzon Economic Corridor pipeline is actually moving from pitch to pavement, and found that most of it is still in the planning stage

items.title: Remulla to block Zaldy’s asylum bid in France
items.description: Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla will block former lawmaker Zaldy Co’s asylum bid in his upcoming visit to France.

items.title: Fuel excise tax relief imminent
items.description: Energy Secretary Sharon Garin has certified that the average price of Dubai crude oil in the past month breached the $80-per-barrel threshold, paving the way for the suspension of excise tax on fuel products.

items.title: Ferry June Aster captain surfaces, faces PCG
items.description: Five days after a fire struck the passenger and cargo ship MV June Aster, its captain, Roel Sarmiento, showed up at the Philippine Coast Guard’s Palawan field office yesterday to shed light on the incident that claimed 76 lives.

items.title: Congress urged: Permanently remove system loss charge
items.description: It’s now the turn of Congress – the Senate and the House of Representatives – to do its part in giving relief to consumers burdened by high electricity bills, by passing a law that would permanently remove the system loss charges, Rep. Arthur Yap of Murang Kuryente party-list said yesterday.

items.title: ICC judges urged to declare Duterte fit for trial
items.description: The prosecutor of the International Criminal Court has urged the judges handling the crimes against humanity case against former president Rodrigo Duterte to declare him fit to stand trial.

items.title: P16.03 billion for ARAL sought to sustain PISA gains
items.description: Education Secretary Sonny Angara on Tuesday urged Congress to approve a P16.03-billion supplemental budget for 2027 to sustain the gains made by Filipino students in the 2025 Program for International Student Assessment through the Academic Recovery and Accessible Learning Program.

items.title: Marcos to ASEAN: Strengthen cooperation on disasters
items.description: President Marcos has called on members of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations to strengthen cooperation on disaster resilience as risks confronting the region are “changing faster than ever.”

items.title: ‘Blanket class suspensions deepen literacy challenges’
items.description: Blanket class suspensions could deepen literacy challenges as schools continue to lose significant teaching days to weather-related hazards, a new study released by the Second Congressional Commission on Education warned.

items.title: VP Sara ready to replace Marcos, says spokesperson
items.description: Vice President Sara Duterte is ready to replace President Marcos in case the latter resigns, according to her spokesman.

items.title: BARMM polls: Federalist party gets big bloc slot
items.description: The Bangsamoro Federalist Party ranked first in the Sept. 14 elections for bloc nominations to the 80-seat parliament of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao, based on initial tallies released by the Commission on Elections yesterday.
